summary: {person} checks how much of a multiyear park promise was delivered during the year just ended.
realLife: Seattle’s June 2026 board presentation listed ten restrooms weatherized in 2025 and twenty-eight across the funding cycle against a goal of sixty.
gates: A multiyear target, a yearly completion count and a cumulative count.
weights: A board member reading both columns aloud may need to clarify their overlap.
inGame: needs: funding cycle target, completed site IDs and the reporting interval.

turns.what: A staff member shows which completions appear in both.
turns.pulledBy: The presenter starts to add the two counts.

turns.what: Staff subtract the cumulative completions from the cycle goal.
turns.writesBack: Publish the outstanding count with its reporting date.
